Privacy Policy — Viet Calendar → Google Calendar

Last updated: 23 July 2026

Viet Calendar ("the extension") is a Chrome extension that creates Google Calendar events from Vietnamese lunar (âm lịch) dates. This policy explains what data it handles and what it does not do with it.

Summary

The extension has no server of its own. It does not send your data to the developer or to any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking service. The only external service it communicates with is Google Calendar, using your own Google account, to do the thing you asked it to do.

What the extension accesses

  • Your Google account email address. After you sign in, the extension reads the email address of your primary calendar so it can show which account is active ("Signed in as…") and let you choose which calendar to use.
  • Authentication (OAuth) token. Signing in uses Google's chrome.identity service to obtain a temporary access token. The token is managed by Chrome and Google and is used only to call the Google Calendar API on your behalf. The extension never sees or stores your password.
  • Calendar data you create. The event details you enter (title, date, time, recurrence, reminder, colour) are sent to your own Google Calendar to create, update, or delete events at your explicit request. The extension can also list your calendars and, if you choose, create a calendar named "Lịch Âm".

What is stored, and where

  • On your device (local browser storage): your settings (interface language, chosen calendar, default reminder and colour) and a list of events you created with the extension, so you can edit or delete them later.
  • Synced by Chrome: if you use Chrome Sync, your settings may sync across your own devices through your Google account. This is handled by Chrome, not by the developer, and is not accessible to the developer.

The developer operates no database or backend and cannot access any of this data.

What the extension does NOT do

  • It does not sell or share your data with third parties.
  • It does not use analytics, advertising, or tracking of any kind.
  • It does not read your browsing history, web pages, or other websites.
  • It does not use your data for any purpose beyond its single stated function: creating Google Calendar events from lunar dates.
  • It does not use your data for creditworthiness or lending purposes.

Data sent to Google

Because the extension works with Google Calendar, the data described above is transmitted to Google under your own account. Google's handling of that data is governed by Google's Privacy Policy.

Removing your data

  • Clear the extension's stored settings and history from its Settings and History screens, or by removing the extension from Chrome.
  • Revoke the extension's access to your Google account at any time at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
  • Events already created in your Google Calendar remain yours; delete them in Google Calendar or via the extension's History screen.

Changes

If this policy changes, the "Last updated" date above will be revised.
